inclusions.source: The half-day runs on a fixed schedule, with hotel pickup included.
The hotel transfer is private to your party; Dolphinella itself is a shared, ticketed facility.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person
inclusions.source: The outing takes bookings from a single person upward, with no minimum group, and one bottle of mineral water per person is provided for the transfer.
The day begins at your hotel, where a guide and vehicle collect you and transfer you to Dolphinella in Hadaba.
Transfer back to your hotel follows, completing the half-day.

exclusions.source: This is handled separately from the tour price and is entirely optional, though the images are the obvious way to document something that is otherwise difficult to photograph yourself.
